name: Gilded Shadows
description: New York, 1889. The Gilded Age glitters with wealth and ambition while the underclass struggles in darkness.
seed_prompt: A historical drama set during America's Gilded Age, where robber barons and reformers clash.
lore_content:
The year is 1889. Electric lights are transforming Manhattan's skyline while families crowd into tenements on the Lower East Side. It is an age of extremes, where fortunes are made and lost in a day.

Catherine Ashworth was born to privilege on Fifth Avenue. Now 28 and unmarried by choice, she scandalizes society by working as a journalist under a male pseudonym. Her investigations into sweatshop conditions have made enemies of powerful men - including her own father.

Thomas Ashworth built his railroad empire on the backs of immigrant laborers. He genuinely believes his wealth benefits society and cannot understand his daughter's 'radical sympathies.' When workers threaten to strike, he'll do whatever it takes to maintain control.

Dr. Marcus Webb runs a free clinic in Five Points, treating the poor who can't afford proper care. A Black man who earned his medical degree in Paris, he faces constant discrimination despite his brilliance. He's documenting the health effects of tenement living for a report that could force legislative action.

Rosa Benedetti organizes garment workers in secret, risking beatings and arrest. She lost her sister to a factory fire and has sworn that no more workers will die for wealthy men's profits. The labor movement is growing, and Rosa is at its heart.

Detective Sean O'Brien walks between worlds as an Irish cop in a department run by Tammany Hall. He takes the bribes he must take to survive but secretly passes information to reformers. When a society girl is murdered, the pressure to find a convenient suspect puts him in an impossible position.

Madame Celestine runs the most exclusive brothel in the Tenderloin. Her clients include senators, industrialists, and foreign dignitaries. The secrets she holds could topple empires - which is why someone is trying to silence her permanently.

Jacob Stern arrived from Poland with nothing and built a garment business through sheer will. Now he stands between the old ways and the new, trying to treat his workers fairly while competing with those who don't. His sons want to expand; his conscience says otherwise.

origins.name: Society Elite
origins.description: Born into wealth and influence, you navigate the intricacies of New York's high society.
traits: Silver Tongue: Advantage on Persuasion checks when dealing with individuals of similar social standing.
Connected: You have access to information and resources within your social circle.

origins.name: Immigrant
origins.description: You arrived in New York seeking a better life, facing prejudice and hardship with resilience.
traits: Hardy: Advantage on saving throws against exhaustion.
Tenacity: Once per long rest, you can reroll a failed saving throw.

origins.name: Working Class
origins.description: You toil in factories, docks, or streets, earning a meager living through hard labor.
traits: Resilient: Gain +1 to maximum hit points per level.
Calloused Hands: Advantage on Strength saving throws against being disarmed.

origins.name: Underworld Denizen
origins.description: You thrive in the shadows, navigating the criminal underbelly of the city.
traits: Shadow Dweller: Advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
Street Smarts: You have advantage on Insight checks to detect lies or deceit in urban environments.

origins.name: Academic
origins.description: You are a scholar and investigator, with a hunger for knowledge and a talent for uncovering secrets.
traits: Keen Mind: You always know which way is north and you always recall where you have been. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.
Researcher: Advantage on ability checks to recall information about historical events, lore, or academic topics.
languages: Two other languages of your choice

archetypes.name: Detective
archetypes.description: A keen observer and investigator, you solve crimes amidst the city's corruption.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: You have advantage on Investigation checks to find clues and analyze evidence.

features.name: Interrogation
features.description: You gain proficiency in Streetwise (Insight). You have advantage on Streetwise checks when interrogating a suspect.

archetypes.name: Reporter
archetypes.description: Driven by truth, you uncover scandals and expose injustice through your writing.

features.name: Incisive Questions
features.description: You can use your action to ask a question to a creature that can understand you. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or truthfully answer the question to the best of its ability.

features.name: Expose
features.description: When you successfully gather information that incriminates a target, you can spend one day writing an expose. If you spend one day in an urban setting after publishing the expose, you can choose to reduce the target's Charisma score by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier.

archetypes.name: Labor Organizer
archetypes.description: You champion the rights of workers, fighting for fair treatment and better conditions.

features.name: Rally the Troops
features.description: As an action, you can inspire your allies. Up to three allies within 30 feet of you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier. They gain advantage on their next saving throw against being frightened or charmed.

features.name: Negotiation
features.description: You gain proficiency in Streetwise (Insight). You have advantage on Streetwise checks when negotiating contracts with employers or addressing concerns with workers.

archetypes.name: Physician
archetypes.description: Dedicated to healing, you provide care to the sick and wounded, often amidst poverty and disease.
starting_equipment: A medical bag with bandages and antiseptic

features.name: First Aid
features.description: As an action, you can administer first aid to a creature within 5 feet. They regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Diagnose
features.description: You can spend 10 minutes studying a creature to diagnose its illness or injury. After doing so, you gain advantage on Medicine checks to treat that creature.

setting_skills.name: Gilded Age Society
setting_skills.description: Navigating the intricate social rules of New York's upper class — calling cards, ballroom etiquette, and the unspoken codes that determine who is received and who is shunned.

setting_skills.name: Labor Organizing
setting_skills.description: Rallying workers, coordinating strikes, and navigating the dangerous politics of the labor movement without getting beaten, arrested, or both.

setting_skills.name: Machine Politics
setting_skills.description: Understanding the corrupt political machinery of Tammany Hall. Knowing which officials can be bought, which can be pressured, and which are genuinely dangerous.

setting_skills.name: Tenement Life
setting_skills.description: Surviving and navigating the overcrowded, disease-ridden tenements of the Lower East Side. Knowing which buildings are safe, where to find help, and how immigrant communities protect their own.
